name: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B

lifecycle.note: NVIDIA has no deprecation page for its open models; the weights were still downloadable from the NVIDIA organisation on Hugging Face on 2026-10-01.

alternatives.note: Publication date of the NVIDIA introduction article on Hugging Face.

sources.locator: Compressing 9B to 4B with Nemotron Elastic; Two-Stage Distillation for Accuracy Recovery

relations.note: Pruned from NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 with the Nemotron Elastic framework, then retrained by knowledge distillation from the frozen 9B parent.

summary.text: Nemotron 3 Nano 4B is a small open-weights text model in NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 family that handles reasoning and non-reasoning tasks. NVIDIA calls it its first model optimised for on-device use and built it by pruning and distilling Nemotron Nano 9B v2 into a hybrid of mostly Mamba-2 layers with about 4B parameters.

changes.text: Compressed from the 9B Nemotron Nano 2 model to about 4B parameters.
Pruning cut depth from 56 to 42 layers and also reduced Mamba heads, feed-forward width and embedding size.
Built for on-device use on Jetson, GeForce RTX and DGX Spark; NVIDIA calls it its first model optimised for that purpose.
Post-trained with a recipe derived from the Nemotron 3 post-training data, with reinforcement learning focused on instruction following and tool calling.

features.note: One model for reasoning and non-reasoning tasks; the reasoning trace can be turned off through the system prompt.

openWeights.note: Released under the NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License in BF16, FP8 and Q4_K_M GGUF.

contextWindowTokens.note: Stated as context length up to 262K.

parameters.note: The introduction article rounds this to 4 billion parameters.

access.note: Positioned for local deployment on Jetson Thor, Jetson Orin Nano, DGX Spark and RTX GPUs.

notes: Not a size variant of the Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B record: a separate release with a different lineage (compressed from Nemotron Nano 9B v2), which NVIDIA calls the newest and most compact member of the Nemotron 3 family. The model card calls the model trained from scratch and, in the same overview, compressed from NVIDIA-Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 (its base_model metadata also names that model); the introduction article confirms the pruning and distillation. Release date: model card 3/16/2026; Hugging Face article March 17, 2026 (alternative). The card says it was improved using Qwen without naming a model (training data, not lineage).
